name: L.A.R.A. Design Tokens
description: Design token dictionary for L.A.R.A. offline LAN classroom applications (Mobile Android, Desktop Tauri, and Server Hub).

primary.comment: Primary classroom learning actions, active tabs, buttons

primaryDark.comment: Hover states, active button press, class card header banner

primaryLight.comment: Selection background, active radio cards, green badge tint

ai.comment: Strictly reserved for Socratic AI Tutor actions, FAB, and indicators

aiDark.comment: Socratic AI header surface and pressed state

canvas.comment: Soft mint-tinted background for main application canvas

white.comment: Surface for cards, dialogs, modals, and sheets

subtle.comment: Hover background for list items and table header cells

primary.comment: High contrast deep navy for headings, questions, and body text

muted.comment: Form placeholders, disabled states, unselected icons

success.comment: SYNCED state, passed scores, connected indicator

warning.comment: QUEUED_OFFLINE state, quiz countdown under 5 minutes

danger.comment: Exam in progress lockout, quiz countdown under 1 minute, delete actions
